meta.title: Expense Splitter
meta.description: Split expenses. Settle up. Stay friends.

landing.headline: Split expenses. Settle up. Stay friends.
landing.body: One shared record of who paid, how it was divided, and what it takes to get square. Built for roommates, trips, and the dinner that nobody wants to spreadsheet.
landing.flexibleBody: Equal, exact amounts, percentages, or shares. The leftover cent goes to the person who paid.
landing.currencyBody: Log a dinner in yen and a train in euros. Balances stay in the group's currency, using the rate from that day.
landing.settleBody: See who owes whom, record a partial payment, and watch the balance update immediately.
landing.peopleBody: Add a roommate by name. They still show up in the split, even if they never sign in.
